gloss: time and effort; time and labor

definitions.gloss: time and effort; time and labor
definitions.explanation: The combination of effort (手間) and time (暇) invested in doing something carefully. Emphasizes that something requires both patience and work.

examples.japanese: {手間暇|てまひま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: To make something with time and effort.

examples.japanese: {手間暇|てまひま}⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: Food made with time and care is delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{手間暇|てまひま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しま→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ず⟦{仕込|しこ}んだ→仕込む：04244_shikomu⟧ものだ。
examples.english: This miso was prepared by a craftsman who spared no time or effort.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧ (effort, labor) and ⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧ (time, free time). Together they emphasize the dual investment of both effort and time. Often used positively to praise careful, dedicated work, especially in food preparation and craftsmanship.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手間暇|てまひま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to put in time and effort
- {手間暇|てまひま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しまない→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧: to spare no time or effort
- {手間暇|てまひま}⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: food made with care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧: effort / labor — focuses on the work involved, without the time component
- ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧: hardship / trouble — implies difficulty and suffering, not just investment of effort
- ⟦{手数|てすう}→手数：30427_tesuu⟧: trouble / bother — often used in polite expressions like ⟦お{手数|てすう}→お手数：06467_otesuu⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧

USAGE:
Very common in food and craft contexts. Advertising and product descriptions often use {手間暇|てまひま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ to emphasize that something was made with care. Can also be written as ⟦{手間|てま}→手間：03554_tema⟧ヒマ or {手間|てま}ひま.
